fact: Project Novus canonical source is TavallStudios/tavall-project-novus main.
TavallMonoRepo is a cross-project integration workspace and is not an alternate source of truth for Project Novus.
tavall-java-tools aggregates canonical Tavall Java tool repositories rather than owning their implementation.
AgentTaskManager uses Qdrant for supplemental semantic retrieval rather than canonical relational truth.
Local BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 384-dimensional embeddings are the default Tavall semantic profile.
Current code topology and pull-request blast radius are retrieved from Graphify-derived workspace graphs.
Curated changing facts, supersession, incidents, and historical relationships are retrieved from Graphiti.
Associative recall, similar fixes, and semantically related project context are retrieved from Qdrant.
Codex session files remain raw evidence references; Tavall memory stores distilled findings rather than duplicating complete conversations.
